name: name
label: Name of the person
help: The person who asked for the test.

name: email
label: Email of the person
help: Excession Labs replies to this address. The service accepts 3 requests a day for each address and 5 a day for each key.

name: targets
label: Targets
help: URLs, API base URLs or a short description of each system to test. Up to 10. Do not add passwords, keys or tokens.

options.label: A customer asked for a pentest report
Before a launch or major release
After an incident or a report

name: timeline
label: Timeline
help: Free text, for example 'before the March release'.

name: notes
label: Notes
help: Do not add passwords, keys or customer data. Access is agreed later through a safe channel.

name: person_consent
label: The person asked for this request and agrees that Excession Labs may email them

name: authorized
label: The person owns these systems or may arrange a test of them
help: Testing still needs written authorization from the system owner later.
